title: PolyWrap vs VSCode
tagline: Polywrap VSCode extension focused on improving the in-IDE developer experience

prizes.placement: Polywrap - Best improvement of the toolchain
prizes.title: Polywrap

description: Providing developers with in-IDE access to Polywrap wrapper registry, API discovery, and lightweight code-generation. The hack was focused on taking Polywrap's amazing work and bringing it natively to VSCode (one of the more popular IDE's out there). It helps address the discoverability issue(s) for both wrappers themselves and a given protocol or contract's API. Beyond this it helps with code-generation by providing snippets that help improve developer productivity.
how_its_made: Really this was all about both Polywrap and VSCode and the hooks they provide with which to make developer's lives easier. Beyond this it was written in NodeJS / TypeScript. With more time I'd tighten up the flow, add an actual registry, and publish it to the VSCode Extension marketplace.
